usage_note: One of the most common fish on Kerala's coast.
Another name for the sardine in many parts of Kerala.
Also used in the Tulu-speaking coast.
A staple of Konkan fish meals.
Plural form; common in Goan kitchens.
Caught with stationary bag nets (dol) off Maharashtra and Gujarat.
Gujarati name; the dried fish is also sold as 'bombil'.
Migrates from the sea into rivers and estuaries.
Prized river-run hilsa of the Godavari.
The origin of the English word 'catamaran'.
Large cantilever net worked from the shore at Kochi.
Fixed net used for Bombay duck; the tide flows fish into it.
Used for 'the sea' in everyday Gujarati.
Name of a fishing community and also used for its members.

meaning_en: Kharva – seafaring and fishing community of Gujarat
Sudden abundance of fish near the shore, linked to monsoon mudbanks
usage_note: Calm, muddy water near the beach and a rush of fish – see the sample story 'Chakara'.
